# C# methods (CPH)

![A Run C# code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-csharp-step.png)

In a **Run C# code** step you can use `CPH`, a toolbox of ready-made methods. `CPH.SendMessage("Hi!")` sends a chat message, `CPH.ObsSetScene("Gameplay")` switches your OBS scene, and so on. The names are the same as in Streamer.bot, so code written for Streamer.bot works in Cuebot.

New to code? Read [Writing code (C# and Python)](../../guides/developers/writing-code.md) first. It shows where the code goes and how a whole script looks. Every example on these pages goes inside `Execute()`:

```csharp
public class CPHInline
{
    public bool Execute()
    {
        // the example goes here
        return true;
    }
}
```
